articles.summary: Delivers Second Quarter Results in Line with Expectations; Reaffirms Full Year Outlook NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection, announced financial results for its second quarter ended September 30, 2026. Remarks by Anil Singhal, NETSCOUT’s President Chief Executive Officer: “Our second-quarter results were consistent with our expectations, and our first half performance keeps us on track for fiscal year 2027. As anticipated, government-related orders that benefited the first quarter shaped our second quarter comparison. Our continued focus on cost discipline drove operating margin expansion from the prior year, and we repurchased approximately $77 million of common stock during the quarter, reflecting our commitment to shareholder returns. We are reaffirming our full-year outlook as we continue to execute on our strategy to drive revenue growth, expand
articles.title: NETSCOUT Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
